## Selected work

- Baysten: AI-assisted professional network. FastAPI matching engine with hybrid retrieval over Weaviate, LLM query analysis, resume parsing, Flutter apps and a React admin.
- Starn22: multi-product commerce platform for Chile with Clara (a streaming AI assistant with tool calling), an AI purchase-order agent, OCR invoice ingestion, SII electronic invoicing and Flutter apps.
- Lightning Chat Bot: voice and chat bots on Amazon Lex and Amazon Connect with Python Lambda fulfilment.
- DataLeon: human-in-the-loop AI data platform with a React/TypeScript review editor.
